test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 25 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: If a certain sum of money becomes double of itself in 5 years 6 months at simple interest, then what will be the annual rate of interest (approximate)?
solution:
**Given:**

Time = 5 years 6 months = 5.5 years

Amount = 2 × Principal

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

Amount = P + SI

**Calculation:**

⇒ SI = Amount − Principal = P

⇒ P = (P × R × 5.5) ÷ 100

⇒ 1 = (R × 5.5) ÷ 100

⇒ R × 5.5 = 100

⇒ R = 100 ÷ 5.5

⇒ R ≈ 18.18%

**∴ The correct answer is 18.18%.**
